content.short: Connecting everyone, everywhere. The first mobile network owned by the people and built on blockchain.
content.description: World Mobile is a decentralized mobile network project that uses blockchain incentives to expand connectivity. The network combines telecom infrastructure with token-based participation, allowing operators and users to support coverage through components such as AirNodes and EarthNodes. Its goal is to make internet access more affordable and community-owned, especially in places underserved by traditional carriers. On Cardano, World Mobile is known for connecting real-world telecom activity with Web3 rewards and network ownership.
content.meta: World Mobile uses blockchain incentives to expand mobile connectivity and network ownership. Explore World Mobile on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
